build_s3_client: build a python module that creates an S3 client for a given bucket using get_client
list_s3_objects: list S3 objects in a bucket prefix using S3Downloader.ls with recursive option
download_s3_file: download an S3 file to a local path using S3Downloader.copy with an optional callback
generate_presigned_url: generate a presigned URL for an S3 object using StreamPathMgr.open with expiration
get_s3_file_desc: get file metadata for an S3 object using S3Downloader.file_desc to retrieve size and path
